name: onboarding-api

dependencies.name: onboarding-db
dependencies.description: Stores new hires, checklist template tasks, generated tasks and notifications.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Validates caller tokens for the onboarding API and provides the caller's role/identity.

description: Owns new hires, the shared checklist template, generated per-hire tasks and notifications. Generates a new hire's checklist from the current template on creation, tracks task status and due dates, computes overdue tasks and raises reminder/escalation notifications. Does not send email or any external notification — reminders are in-app only.
